title: Roadmap planning must skip tasks a live claim already reserves
goal: The queue planner ordered tasks by priority without consulting live claims, so a plan named the GMCP task another worker held and the mission died at claim time before a token was spent. Read the live claim ids from origin and skip any candidate whose scopes overlap a claimed task's scopes, with a unit test that a claimed task and its overlapping neighbour are left out while a disjoint task remains.
